metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the worst neck pain relief exercises, and the BEST ones to do instead. 

We'll go over 4 common, but bad, neck pain stretches and exercises that may do more harm than good. Each exercise will focus on a different movement (and location) of the neck.

Make sure to check out all of the exercises, it might just save your neck down the road!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:50 Twisting
4:02 Side Bending (Side of Neck Pain)
6:58 Extension (Bending Backward)
